page.text:
The Rank-Nullity Theorem establishes that any linear map $T : V \to W$
satisfies $\dim(V) = \dim(\ker T) + \dim(\operatorname{im} T)$.
Geometrically, the dimension of the domain is partitioned into the
degrees of freedom destroyed (collapsed into the kernel) and the degrees
of freedom preserved (mapped into the image).
